en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3492 - It is narrated from Al-Qasim ibn Sulayman, from Abu Abdullah (as):

Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) used to allow a mukatab (a slave under a contract of emancipation) to continue working to pay off his contract, because at that time they did not stipulate that if he failed, he would return to slavery.
Abu Abdullah (as), said: "They are bound by their conditions."
Imam (as) also said: "A mukatab is given a period of three installments. If he fails to make the payments, he is returned to slavery."
